common_room.title: Common room
common_room.text: A low room that smells of woodsmoke. A cold hearth fills one wall. Stairs lead down; a door stands to the east.

east.locked_text: The east door is locked. The keyhole is old and large.

cellar.title: Cellar
cellar.text: Barrels line the walls. Something glints on a shelf.
cellar.dark_text: It is pitch black. You can hear water dripping somewhere.

yard.title: Yard
yard.text: Cold air and open sky. The road east disappears into the hills. You've found your way out.

lantern.name: brass lantern
lantern.text: A brass lantern with a little oil left in it.

note.name: folded note
note.text: It reads: 'Spare key in the cellar. Bring a light.'

key.name: iron key
key.text: A heavy iron key, older than the door it opens.

interactions.says: The wick catches. Warm light spills out around you.

interactions.text: unlock the east door with the iron key
interactions.says: The key turns with a heavy clunk. The east door is unlocked.
